cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Win the Smaller Concession
cards.instruction: Get one small surrender, then use its logic to make the larger claim harder to defend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you send that speech, acknowledge the paragraph I helped write.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The opening paragraph, yes. I'll thank you for that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the opening sets out the argument you use in the rest. Put that in the thanks too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not crediting you with the whole speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the wording as yours. Credit me with the argument, then show me where the opening stops doing work. You can claim the rest once you've shown me where mine ends.

reason: Clarify that A claims the continuing argument and permits B ownership only beyond its demonstrated end; do not accidentally make A settle for independent B material.
